description: Defines a class for a command-line application to toggle display of metrics in STDOUT, including subcommands management and creation function.

classes.name: toggle_stdout_metrics_app_command
classes.description: Represents a command to toggle stdout metrics display with subcommands management.

classes.name: metrics_subcommand
classes.description: Interface for individual metrics subcommands, providing methods for name retrieval, header printing, enabling, and disabling.

methods.name: toggle_stdout_metrics_app_command
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command with available subcommands and auto-start option.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command with provided arguments.

methods.name: execute_subcommand
methods.description: Executes a specific subcommand based on index.

methods.name: get_subcommand_index
methods.description: Finds the index of a subcommand matching given arguments.

methods.name: stop_current_active_subcommand
methods.description: Stops the currently active subcommand if it differs from the given index.
